name: Grauwe pijlstormvogel
label: Bijzondere vogel
desc: After breeding on the Falklands in the southern summer, Sooty Shearwaters make their way up north along Brazil, the Caribbean, the USA all the way up to Greenland, where they turn around and go back south along Europe and Africa  before making their way back to the breeding grounds on the Falklands. Around september, they pass the North Sea and when the wind comes from the west you can see them from the Dutch coast. Today, finally everything worked together and I got to see my first.
